population.span: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial conducted in 3 Spanish teaching hospitals involving patients with both severe community-acquired pneumonia and a high inflammatory response, which was defined as a level of C-reactive protein greater than 150 mg/L at admission.

endpoint.span: Hyperglycemia occurred in 11 patients (18%) in the methylprednisolone group and in 7 patients (12%) in the placebo group (P = .34).

estimate.span: Hyperglycemia occurred in 11 patients (18%) in the methylprednisolone group and in 7 patients (12%) in the placebo group (P = .34).

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomized to receive either an intravenous bolus of 0.5 mg/kg per 12 hours of methylprednisolone (n = 61) or placebo (n = 59) for 5 days started within 36 hours of hospital admission.

absent_reason.ci: Neither held abstract nor the registry reports a confidence interval for hyperglycemia.
absent_reason.analysis_set: No source states the analysis population used for the hyperglycemia counts.
absent_reason.follow_up: No source specifies the hyperglycemia assessment timepoint or duration; treatment duration and primary-outcome timeframes do not establish it.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The abstracts describe hospitalized patients with severe community-acquired pneumonia and high inflammation; the registry confirms adult eligibility. This restricted entry population falls within the question.
entry_population_matches_question.span: ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 18 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

notes: The served hyperglycemia counts match the abstract. Only abstracts and a registry are held, and none reports a hyperglycemia confidence interval. Randomized arm sizes are 61 and 59, but their use as hyperglycemia analysis denominators is not explicitly stated; no denominators, RR or CI were inferred. Registry evidence was used to establish adult eligibility.
